title: Association of Baseline Serum DKK-1 Levels with Subsequent Bone Metastasis in Stage III Breast Cancer.
snippet: : Bone metastasis is the most frequent site of distant spread in breast cancer, yet reliable biomarkers capable of identifying patients at increased risk before metastatic disease becomes clinically evident remain limited.
